ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the issue of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of the Minnesota DHS to address the issue.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?

ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability.
